title: SMOOTH FIRST SWING WELCOME PASS
description: The feature rebuilds routine play around the moment a player considers leaving. The opening combat pass now lets attacks cancel cleanly into dodge, loot pickup, and the inevitable tutorial popover. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: Players blamed themselves for failure instead of the input queue, which design marked as a milestone. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.

title: SMOOTH FIRST SWING EXPERT MODE
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. The opening combat pass now lets attacks cancel cleanly into dodge, loot pickup, and the inevitable tutorial popover. New systems lean into late-game complexity for players already fluent in the existing disaster.
consequence: Players blamed themselves for failure instead of the input queue, which design marked as a milestone. The audience got smaller, sharper, and much harder to onboard at parties.

title: COMMITTED INTERACTION TIMING WELCOME PASS
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Gathering, crafting, and chest opening now include deliberate windups to make the world feel physically expensive. Early sessions now surface clearer genre hooks for players who have not memorized the wiki by birth.
consequence: Every common action gained weight. Most of it landed on the player's patience. The game waved at strangers without asking them to craft a spreadsheet first.
